atoms.title: The Piano
atoms.b: The piano is a keyboard instrument. It has many black and white keys. Every key plays a different tone.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-piano-4</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> The piano is a keyboard instrument. It has many black and white keys. Every key plays a different tone.

atoms.b: Most pianos have 88 keys: 52 white keys and 36 black.
atoms.sound: ssml: Most piannos have 88 keys: <break time='1000ms'/> 52 white keys and 36 black.

atoms.b: The further to the left a key is, the lower the tone it plays. The higher tones are further to the right.
atoms.sound: The further to the left a key is, the lower the tone it plays.<voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>c1-piano</voice> The higher tones are further to the right. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>c4-piano</voice>

What colours are the keys of the piano?

hint.text: When you play multiple tones at the same time, this is called a chord.
hint.label: Did you know?

atoms.title: How do you play a piano?
atoms.b: In order to play many tones at the same time you use all ten fingers.
atoms.sound: ssml: How do you play a piano? <break time='1000ms'/> In order to play many tones at the same time you use all ten fingers. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>custom-piano-chord</voice>

hint.text: To dampen means to soften the sound of the notes. The tones become softer and duller.
hint.label: Dampen

atoms.b: The piano also has foot pedals. The pedals are used to dampen the tones or hold notes longer.
atoms.sound: The piano also has foot pedals. The pedals are used to dampen the tones or hold notes longer. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>custom-piano-velocity-length</voice>

atoms.a: What do you play a piano with?

atoms.b: With the foot pedals you can ((make_the_tones_higher_and_deeper ++lengthen_and_dampen_the_tones)).
